reasoning: Both attempts virtualize the list, size the canvas from the count, use one clock that runs only while open, and derive the age text. A drops all rows while closed and adapts to the viewport size, but it changes Main.client.luau to grow the shared table in place, an out-of-scope change with side-effect risk, and its doc gives no way to count GUI objects or get before numbers. B leaves Main alone, uses a simple and correct fixed pool, and its doc is fuller and more measurable. B's only weakness is the hard-coded window height. B wins narrowly.

criteria.note: visibleRows builds only firstSlot..lastSlot (viewport ± OVERSCAN), keyed by slot % poolSize so frames are recycled; no rows while closed.
CanvasSize = n*ROW_HEIGHT + (n-1)*ROW_GAP from count(), matching the old layout.
One Heartbeat inside an effect gated on props.IsOpen(), cleaned up on close, refreshes now on open.
ageText is a derive of formatAge(...), so Text is written only when the string changes.
Slot→index n-slot keeps newest first; derives on item fields refresh recycled frames; header and live updates intact, though it relies on re-setting a mutated table.
Explains the changes, gives a 3,000-entry fill script, profiler/FPS/Explorer steps and visual checks, but no GUI-count command and no way to get before numbers.
Passes all checks and is typed, but mutating placed() in place in Main.client.luau is an out-of-scope change with side-effect risk.
A fixed SLOT_COUNT pool of rows, each with a displayIndex derive from scrollY that refills one slot per row scrolled.
One PreRender connection in an effect gated on IsOpen, cleaned up on close.
ageText derive is bound to Text, so it is written only when the string changes.
entry derive reads list[#list - displayIndex + 1], so new placements and scrolls refresh every slot; rows past the end are hidden; color, type, position, age and header are kept.
Before/after table, fill script, GetDescendants count command, closed/open profiler, MicroProfiler scrolling and placement steps, visual checks, and how to get before numbers.
Only PlacedList changed and all checks pass; WINDOW_HEIGHT is hard-coded from the panel constants rather than measured.

strengths: Adaptive virtualization from AbsoluteWindowSize with overscan
Zero rows and zero per-frame work while closed
Rows recycled by slot % poolSize; pool sizing verified
weaknesses: In-place mutation of the shared placed table in Main.client.luau
Doc lacks a GUI-object-count command and a way to get before numbers

strengths: Simple fixed pool with congruent slot mapping
Thorough, measurable doc with a before/after table and a GUI-count command
weaknesses: Window height is computed from constants, not AbsoluteWindowSize
The pool rows and their derives exist even while closed (cheap, but not zero)
